curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain that a bicycle is a vehicle with the same rights and duties, that penalties and records match, and that riders obey every signal and ride with traffic.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card for obeying signals and riding with the flow.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on a rider's rights, duties, and penalties.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach where riders position themselves on one-way and two-way roads, the exceptions to keeping right, riding two abreast, shoulders, and shared lane markings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each position rule; contrast cards for left versus right edge and the lane-sharing rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a road and asking where the rider belongs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the arm signals for turns and stops, the seat and passenger rule, the hitching ban, and keeping one hand on the handlebars.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each signal and conduct rule; contrast cards for the three arm signals and the conduct bans.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on arm signals and rider conduct.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the brake standard, the safety flag for riders with hearing loss, and the night lamp and reflector requirements.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for brakes, flags, and night equipment; a contrast card for required versus optional night gear.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on required bicycle equipment.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover local helmet laws, shared walkways and stopping off the street, choosing routes, mirrors and bright clothing, and riding in rain.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each habit; a contrast card linking helmets, routes, visibility, and rain hazards.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on safe riding habits.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec13-m01..sec13-m05; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
